name: MillerKnoll, Inc.
summary: MillerKnoll, Inc. researches, designs, manufactures, sells, and distributes interior furnishings worldwide. It operates through North America Contract, International Contract, and Global Retail segments. The company also provides seating products, furniture systems, other freestanding furniture elements, textiles, leather, felt, home furnishings and related services; and casegoods, storage products, and acoustic products and related services, as well as residential, education, and healthcare furniture solutions.
